title: SQL FCI topology: the 4-node WSFC + the shared disk
description: The nexus-cli topology verb for the SQL Server FCI: the full 4-node WSFC (2 FCI + 2 AG replicas as voters) + the FCI shared disk as the single shard.

observe.what: 2 fci-active/passive nodes + 2 wsfc-member (the AG replicas vote in quorum) + the fci-shared-disk shard on S:\\ owned by the active node

whatProves: the FCI is a single-instance shared-storage cluster: one disk (the iSCSI LUN) owned by the active node, inside a 4-node NodeMajority WSFC.
